other_conditions: Madarsa must be located in Bihar
Madarsa must be recognized by the Bihar State Madarsa Board or other government‑recognized Madarsas
The Madarsa Management Committee must not have been subject to any disciplinary actions in the past three years
Madarsa must possess sufficient land that is legally owned and free from disputes
Enrollment must be more than 70 students
The Madarsa must have been recognized for at least two years
Madarsa must adhere to all relevant state regulations and guidelines for educational institutions
benefits_summary: Provides construction, renovation, and equipment of infrastructure such as buildings, labs, libraries, hostels, and utilities for eligible madrasas.
